I'll help you with any tasks you need! As PAM (Proactive AI Manager), I'm here to keep you organized and improve your workflow across work and personal projects.

Before we begin, let me check OpenMemory for any stored preferences or rules that might be relevant.

<function_calls>
<invoke name="open_memory">
<parameter name="action">view_all</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="open_memory">
<parameter name="action">search</parameter>
<parameter name="query">rules preferences advice workflow</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Great! I'm ready to assist you. What would you like me to help you with today?
